{"code":"local function route(grid, teleporters)
  local rows, cols = #grid, #grid[1]
  local count = rows * cols
  local cells, entry = {}, {}
  local start, goal
  for r = 1, rows do
    for c = 1, cols do
      local i = (r - 1) * cols + c
      local ch = string.byte(grid[r], c)
      cells[i] = ch
      entry[i] = ch == 126 and 3 or 1
      if ch == 83 then start = i elseif ch == 71 then goal = i end
    end
  end
  local targets, weights = {}, {}
  for j = 1, #teleporters do
    local t = teleporters[j]
    local src = (t.fr - 1) * cols + t.fc
    local dst = (t.tr - 1) * cols + t.tc
    if not targets[src] then targets[src], weights[src] = {}, {} end
    local w = weights[src]
    if w[dst] == nil then
      local list = targets[src]
      list[#list + 1] = dst
      w[dst] = t.cost
    elseif t.cost < w[dst] then
      w[dst] = t.cost
    end
  end
  local dist, actions, heap, position = {}, {}, {}, {}
  local size = 1
  dist[start], actions[start], heap[1], position[start] = 0, 0, start, 1
  local function less(u, v)
    return dist[u] < dist[v] or (dist[u] == dist[v] and actions[u] < actions[v])
  end
  local function offer(cell, keys, cost, steps)
    local ch = cells[cell]
    if ch == 35 then return end
    if ch == 65 and keys % 2 == 0 then return end
    if ch == 66 and keys < 2 then return end
    if ch == 97 and keys % 2 == 0 then keys = keys + 1 end
    if ch == 98 and keys < 2 then keys = keys + 2 end
    local id = keys * count + cell
    if position[id] == -1 then return end
    local old = dist[id]
    if old ~= nil and (cost > old or (cost == old and steps >= actions[id])) then return end
    dist[id], actions[id] = cost, steps
    local p = position[id]
    if p == nil then size = size + 1; p = size end
    while p > 1 do
      local parent = math.floor(p / 2)
      local other = heap[parent]
      if not less(id, other) then break end
      heap[p], position[other] = other, p
      p = parent
    end
    heap[p], position[id] = id, p
  end
  local dr, dc = {-1, 1, 0, 0}, {0, 0, -1, 1}
  local direction = {94, 118, 60, 62}
  while size > 0 do
    local id = heap[1]
    local last = heap[size]
    heap[size] = nil
    size = size - 1
    position[id] = -1
    if size > 0 then
      local p = 1
      while p * 2 <= size do
        local child = p * 2
        if child < size and less(heap[child + 1], heap[child]) then child = child + 1 end
        local other = heap[child]
        if not less(other, last) then break end
        heap[p], position[other] = other, p
        p = child
      end
      heap[p], position[last] = last, p
    end
    local keys = math.floor((id - 1) / count)
    local cell = id - keys * count
    local cost, steps = dist[id], actions[id]
    if cell == goal then return {cost = cost, actions = steps} end
    local r = math.floor((cell - 1) / cols) + 1
    local c = cell - (r - 1) * cols
    for d = 1, 4 do
      local nr, nc = r + dr[d], c + dc[d]
      if nr >= 1 and nr <= rows and nc >= 1 and nc <= cols then
        local dst = (nr - 1) * cols + nc
        local ch = cells[dst]
        if (ch ~= 94 and ch ~= 118 and ch ~= 60 and ch ~= 62) or ch == direction[d] then
          offer(dst, keys, cost + entry[dst], steps + 1)
        end
      end
    end
    local list = targets[cell]
    if list then
      local w = weights[cell]
      for j = 1, #list do
        local dst = list[j]
        offer(dst, keys, cost + w[dst], steps + 1)
      end
    end
  end
  return {cost = -1, actions = -1}
end

logic_define('min_doors_to_exit', function(inventory)
  local s = snapshot()
  local start, goal = locate('Player', s), locate('Exit', s)
  if start == 'none' or goal == 'none' then return -1 end
  if start == goal then return 0 end
  local keys = {
    {room=locate('Key_Red', s), bit=1},
    {room=locate('Key_Blue', s), bit=2},
    {room=locate('Key_Gold', s), bit=4}
  }
  local function collect(room, mask)
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      if key.room == room and not has(mask, key.bit) then mask = mask + key.bit end
    end
    return mask
  end
  local mask = collect(start, inventory_mask(inventory))
  local queue, head = {{room=start, mask=mask, distance=0}}, 1
  local visited = {[start..':'..mask]=true}
  while head <= #queue do
    local state = queue[head]
    head = head + 1
    if state.room == goal then return state.distance end
    for _, edge in ipairs(s.adj[state.room]) do
      if opens(edge.colour, state.mask) then
        local nextMask = collect(edge.to, state.mask)
        local id = edge.to..':'..nextMask
        if not visited[id] then
          visited[id] = true
          queue[#queue+1] = {room=edge.to, mask=nextMask, distance=state.distance+1}
        end
      end
    end
  end
